name: new-pet-preparation
description:
Guides pre-arrival preparation for a new dog or cat including essential supplies, home safety proofing, first-week schedule, and veterinary appointment planning. Produces a complete checklist and day-by-day plan for the first week.
Use when the user asks about bringing home a new puppy, kitten, adult dog, or cat, what supplies to buy, how to pet-proof a home, or what to expect during the first week.
Do NOT use for training protocols (use dog-training-fundamentals), ongoing health monitoring (use pet-health-monitoring), nutrition planning (use pet-nutrition-guide), or exotic pet care.
